strengths.I004-v2: The CPPI multiplier is the stress-correlated sum of cluster tail losses (correlation set to 1), so exposure is sized directly against a joint sell-off. The exposure floor is derived to keep a 4-point margin under 20%, and the asymmetric ramps shed risk twice as fast as they restore it.
strengths.I008-v2: Stress-day covariance and a stock-bond-correlation-driven shift of budget from rates to real assets respond directly to 2008-style correlation spikes and 2022-style bond failure. A fifth-of-gap daily sleeve is a natural staggered execution.

verdicts.reason: I004's cushion is sized against a correlated tail loss and reaches its floor at 16% drawdown with a derived margin, whereas I008's floor m = clip(6*(1-0.8*HWM/NAV),0,1) only reaches zero exposure at exactly 20% drawdown, leaving no reserve for trading lag or gap moves.

strengths.I003-v2: The design is minimal and fully specified: cushion-proportional exposure goes to zero at 16% drawdown, leaving a 4% slippage reserve. A week-to-date turnover budget that reserves room for the remaining days, plus a forced minimum swap, makes both the turnover and trade-frequency gates hold by construction.
strengths.I008-v2: It is more novel in its crisis-aware risk model: stress-set covariance shrinkage and a correlation-contingent shift in budget from rates to real assets target the 2022 regime that plain risk parity mishandles.

verdicts.reason: I003 reaches zero exposure at 16% drawdown, with an explicit 4% reserve under the 20% bound, whereas I008's floor zeroes exposure only at 20% itself, so any execution lag breaches the target; I008 also has many more tuned parameters and no forced minimum trade.

strengths.I004-v2: Risk is spread across clusters with ERC on the full covariance (risk share of 1/3 by rule), and the de-risking multiplier is scaled by the portfolio's own correlated tail loss rather than by a fixed constant. Trend gates add a second de-risking layer.
strengths.I003-v2: It has fewer parameters and a cleaner control law. The weekly-budgeted daily ramp, with a reserve kept for remaining days, is an elegant by-construction satisfaction of the turnover and frequency gates, and exposure reaches zero at 16% drawdown.

verdicts.reason: I004 sizes the drawdown cushion by the summed stress-tail cluster losses (explicitly addressing correlated sell-offs) and equalises risk contributions including correlations, whereas I003 uses a fixed cushion multiplier and inverse-volatility weights that ignore correlation, leaving its 60% bond weight exposed in 2022.
